provenance: All content written for this project; not consulted against R-010 (מאל"ו), R-013 (AnkiWeb), or any NC-licensed dictionary.
source: data/amirnet-vocab.csv (Tier 1, A2) — continuing the alphabetical single-word Tier-1 sweep. manifest-2026-09-17-4.json (the previous CONTENT tick, C-0710) recorded its own next_marker as "seafood" after covering sample..script. Re-verified live rather than trusted: re-derived the missing single-word Tier-1 headword list from data/amirnet-vocab.csv against every existing batch-*.jsonl headword (253 clean single-word Tier-1 headwords still missing, 1037/3382 Tier1+2 existing per npm run measure:amirnet-coverage before this batch), and "seafood" was confirmed as the first missing single-word Tier-1 headword after "script". This batch covers 25 of the 29 single-word Tier-1 headwords in the seafood..silly alphabetical span (4 deliberately skipped — see skipped_this_span), deferring multi-word/compound headwords in the same span, same convention as prior ticks.
skipped_this_span: Four headwords inside the seafood..silly alphabetical span were deliberately NOT written this tick: "sense" (too polysemous — meaning/one-of-five-senses/common-sense — to commit to a single dominant sense under this tick's time budget), "shall" (modal auxiliary, needs its own modal-specific item design rather than the declarative 3-stem pattern used here), "shoot" (its dominant dictionary sense involves a weapon; a safer photography sense exists but was not clearly dominant enough to commit to at A2 without more research), and "silently" (adverb, left for a future tick alongside "silver"/"similar"/"simple" onward — a batch-size cutoff, not a content problem). All four remain missing from the bank and are candidates for a future tick, ideally with a second sense-disambiguation pass for "sense" and "shoot".
gate_method: gateSense (lib/core/contentSchema.ts) imported directly via a temporary node script (not committed) and run on every row against the real allowed-words-2026-08-07.txt. First-draft level drift (9 of 25 rows flagged on the first pass — background words not on the allow-list: "hidden"/"treasure" in a search item, "apple" in a seed example, "september"/"math"/"english" in semester examples, "torn" in a sew item, "cloudy" in a shadow item, "chick"/"nut" in shell content, "sunset" in a shore example, "flu"/"needles" in shot items, "privacy" in a shut item) were fixed with allow-listed replacements (each replacement word checked individually with grep -x before reuse), then re-verified to 25/25 in the second round. Rejected-and-discarded rows: 0 — every rejection was repaired once, per R-014.
distractor_allowed_words_note: Distractor words were not individually checked against allowed-words-2026-08-07.txt (gateSense does not read allowedWords for distractors at all — a known, previously recorded gap, e.g. manifest-2026-09-17-4.json). Distractors used are simple, universally-known basic words already reused as distractors across many prior batches (banana, guitar, chair, pencil, elephant, mountain, orange among the 'unrelated' set).
he_one_to_many_note: "shade" and "shadow" both translate to "צל" — a genuine one-to-many collision within this same batch, tagged he_one_to_many_group on both rows and flagged in he_interference_note. "shore" ("חוף") also overlaps with the existing bank's "beach"/"coast" senses and is tagged accordingly. No other collision was found by grepping the other 22 translation_he values against the existing bank.
translation_confidence_note: 24 of 25 rows are translation_confidence:"high". 1 row ("silly") is "low": the Hebrew register for "silly" (harmless, mild foolishness) does not map cleanly onto a single Hebrew word without either sounding too harsh (מטומטם) or too narrow — "מטופש" was used but flagged low per the rule to never omit for uncertainty.
batch_size_note: 25 rows, one sense each, full apparatus (2 examples, 3 leveled items, 4 tagged distractors) per row. T-353 — which would make sentences/items/distractors optional per Roy's 14/09 volume instruction — is still ⬜ (checked live in plan/50-tasks.md before choosing batch size: `grep -n '^| T-353 |' plan/50-tasks.md` shows no ✅ marker; row text unchanged since 14/09, still blocked on lib/core/contentSchema.ts, scripts/build-ingest-sql.mjs and lib/core/spotCheck.ts, none of which CONTENT may touch). ⇒ THIS TICK WAS BLOCKED ON T-353 for the volume-only mode Roy asked for, and wrote the full-apparatus form instead because gateSense/build:ingest/spotCheck still reject a sentence-less row. 25 was sized to what this tick could hand-author and hand-check carefully within its window, given roughly 40 minutes were spent in Smart Wait for DEV's lock before this tick's own lock could be acquired — well under the 1,200-row-per-file ceiling.
next_marker: next alphabetical Tier-1 single-word headword after "silly", not already covered by any existing batch-*.jsonl, is "silver". "sense", "shall", "shoot" and "silently" (all inside the seafood..silly span) remain missing too — see skipped_this_span.
